description: This file manages task registry maintenance, including task state reconciliation, cleanup, pruning, and scheduled sweeps. It interacts with session stores, cron jobs, and agent contexts to determine task statuses and perform maintenance operations.

methods.name: findSessionEntryByKey
methods.description: Finds a session entry in the store by session key, case-insensitive.

methods.name: isActiveTask
methods.description: Checks if a task is active (queued or running).

methods.name: isTerminalTask
methods.description: Checks if a task is terminal (not active).

methods.name: hasLostGraceExpired
methods.description: Determines if the grace period for a lost task has expired.

methods.name: hasActiveCliRun
methods.description: Checks if a CLI run is active for the task.

methods.name: hasBackingSession
methods.description: Determines if the task has an active backing session based on runtime and session store.

methods.name: shouldMarkLost
methods.description: Decides if a task should be marked as lost based on grace and session status.

methods.name: shouldPruneTerminalTask
methods.description: Decides if a terminal task should be pruned based on retention period.

methods.name: shouldStampCleanupAfter
methods.description: Checks if cleanup timestamp should be stamped on a terminal task.

methods.name: resolveCleanupAfter
methods.description: Calculates cleanup timestamp for a task.

methods.name: markTaskLost
methods.description: Marks a task as lost and updates its status.

methods.name: projectTaskLost
methods.description: Projects a task's state as lost with updated timestamps and error.

methods.name: reconcileTaskRecordForOperatorInspection
methods.description: Reconciles a task record for operator inspection, marking it lost if necessary.

methods.name: reconcileInspectableTasks
methods.description: Returns a list of all tasks reconciled for inspection.

methods.name: getInspectableTaskRegistrySummary
methods.description: Provides a summary of the task registry for inspection.

methods.name: getInspectableTaskAuditSummary
methods.description: Provides an audit summary of the task registry.

methods.name: reconcileTaskLookupToken
methods.description: Resolves and reconciles a task by its lookup token.

methods.name: previewTaskRegistryMaintenance
methods.description: Provides a preview summary of maintenance actions without modifying tasks.

methods.name: runTaskRegistryMaintenance
methods.description: Performs maintenance on the task registry, including marking lost and pruning tasks.

methods.name: sweepTaskRegistry
methods.description: Executes a full sweep of task registry maintenance.

methods.name: startTaskRegistryMaintenance
methods.description: Starts scheduled maintenance for the task registry.

methods.name: stopTaskRegistryMaintenanceForTests
methods.description: Stops scheduled maintenance, used for testing.

methods.name: getReconciledTaskById
methods.description: Retrieves and reconciles a task by ID.
